LESSON: SLAB MODELLIN G TECHNIQU

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. model items using slab techniques
2. model for enjoyment
3. express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. products appreciate own and others work. working area and wash their hands. Core-Competence 92

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. model items using slab techniques
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to model items using slab techniques. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. model for enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to model for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. products appreciate own and others work. working area and wash their hands. Core-Competence 92
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. products appreciate own and others work. working area and wash their hands. Core-Competence 92. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU.
2. Explain Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU.
4. Show that you can: model items using slab techniques
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Slab MODELLIN G TECHNIQU important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. model items using slab techniques
2. model for enjoyment
3. express their ideas, feelings and emotions through modelling. products appreciate own and others work. working area and wash their hands. Core-Competence 92

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
